description: This file defines the interface class IGstGenericPlayerClient for the Rialto GStreamer player. It declares methods for notifying the client about playback state, media data needs, position updates, network state, QoS updates, buffer underflow events, and cache management. The interface is intended for implementation by objects that handle playback notifications and data provision in the Rialto media framework.

classes.name: IGstGenericPlayerClient
classes.description: Abstract base class for Rialto GStreamer player client notifications, defining methods for playback state, media data requests, position, network state, QoS, buffer underflow, and cache management.

methods.name: notifyPlaybackState
methods.description: Notify client of the current playback state (e.g., IDLE, PLAYING, PAUSED, SEEKING, FLUSHED, STOPPED).

methods.name: notifyNeedMediaData
methods.description: Notify client that media data is needed for a specific media source type; returns true on success.

methods.name: notifyPosition
methods.description: Notify client of the current playback position in nanoseconds.

methods.name: notifyNetworkState
methods.description: Notify client of the current network state.

methods.name: clearActiveRequestsCache
methods.description: Clear all active media data request caches.

methods.name: invalidateActiveRequests
methods.description: Invalidate active media data requests for a specific media source type.

methods.name: notifyQos
methods.description: Notify client of QoS updates for a media source.

methods.name: notifyBufferUnderflow
methods.description: Notify client that a buffer underflow has occurred for a media source.
